dedupe_keys.name: in depth analysis of tram curve noise dataset for rigorous noise assessment

description: In-Depth Analysis of Tram Curve Noise Dataset for Rigorous Noise Assessment is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Sakdirat Kaewunruen et al. The growth of cities, both socially and economically, has resulted in a higher utilization of trains and high-density mobility. However, this has also led to an escalation of urban environmental issues, specifically pertaining to noise generated by rail operations. The amplified contact between wheels and rails, as well as the vibrations in trains and track structures, contributes to railway noise pollution. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: CSV, Python. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
